item.title: WXYZ wins prestigious duPont-Columbia Award for investigation into traveling troubled cops
item.description: An investigation detailing how disgraced police officers were able to find new badges throughout Michigan has been honored with the highest honor in broadcast journalism.

item.title: Detroit volunteers count homeless population to help shape policy, secure federal funding
item.description: Volunteers, outreach workers and city leaders fanned out across Detroit to count the number of people living without permanent shelter, part of an effort that helps shape policy and direct resources.

item.title: Gov. Whitmer opens art and writing contests for K-12 students ahead of State of the State
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer is calling on students to have their creativity highlighted during a big event.
